text: 上海亚虹公告，宁生集团、谢亚明、谢悦与上海飞科投资有限公司签署股份转让协议，合计拟转让公司29.99%股份，转让价格21.43元/股，转让总价8.9976亿元；飞科投资拟以21.43元/股部分要约收购1429.4万股（10.21%），宁生集团、谢亚明分别预受797.92万股（5.70%）、631.48万股（4.51%）。公司股票将于2026年9月17日开市起复牌。
text_en: Shanghai Yahong announced that Ningsheng Group, Xie Yaming, Xie Yue and Shanghai Flyco Investment Co., Ltd. signed a share transfer agreement, proposing to transfer a total of 29.99% of the company's shares at a transfer price of RMB 21.43 per share, for a total transfer price of RMB 899.76 million; Flyco Investment plans to make a partial tender offer for 14.294 million shares (10.21%) at RMB 21.43 per share, with Ningsheng Group and Xie Yaming pre-accepting 7.9792 million shares (5.70%) and 6.3148 million shares (4.51%) respectively. The company's shares will resume trading at market open on September 17, 2026.
